name: octonote
description: Notes and editable diagrams your assistant writes, keeps and publishes: rich notes with math and diagrams, canvases drawn from flowcharts and class diagrams, notebooks, and one-step publishing.

interface.longDescription:
Octonote turns your chats into things you keep. Ask ChatGPT to write a note, and it becomes a real document with headings, tables, code, LaTeX math and diagrams. Ask it to draw something, and you get an editable canvas: flowcharts and class diagrams become real shapes you can move and restyle, with boxes that can link to code on GitHub.

What you can ask:
- Save a write-up as a note, optionally in a notebook.
- Draw a flowchart or class diagram as an editable canvas.
- Pair a write-up with a diagram as a project.
- Find a note you saved before and add to it.
- Organise items into notebooks, rename or move them.
- Publish a clean public page and get its link, or share an item with someone by email.

Privacy and control: ChatGPT acts as you and sees only what your account can see. Nothing is published, shared or deleted unless you ask. Disconnect any time in Octonote Settings → Connected apps.

Who it is for: anyone who wants good answers to stop disappearing into chat history: engineers writing design docs and diagrams, students keeping study notes with math, and teams publishing explainers.

Limitations: canvases are drawn from flowcharts and class diagrams; other diagram types appear inside notes. Free accounts hold 10 notes, 10 canvases, 10 projects and 10 notebooks; Pro is unlimited.
capabilities: Write rich notes with math, tables and diagrams
Draw flowcharts and class diagrams as editable canvases
Link diagram boxes to code on GitHub
Pair a write-up and a diagram as a project
Publish a public page in one step
defaultPrompt: Save what we decided as a note with a checklist of next steps.
Draw our signup flow as a canvas.
Find my note about caching and add today's decision to it.

positive.description: Find content. The reviewer account has a Getting started notebook with a Welcome to Octonote note.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Welcome to Octonote (note) with an octonote.ai link.

positive.prompt: Open my Welcome to Octonote note and summarise it.
positive.expected_behavior: A summary mentioning the checklist of things to try, the hit-rate formula and the cache flowchart.

positive.prompt: Create a note called Meeting notes with three action items as a checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: A new note named Meeting notes with a three-item checklist, returned with its octonote.ai link.

positive.description: Draw a canvas from a flowchart.
positive.prompt: Draw a canvas of an order flow: cart, checkout, payment ok?, confirmation, or back to checkout.
positive.expected_behavior: A new canvas with five shapes (including a decision) and connecting arrows, returned with its link.

positive.prompt: Create a notebook called Ideas and move Meeting notes into it.
positive.expected_behavior: A notebook named Ideas exists and contains Meeting notes.

negative.description: Unsupported canvas type. Sequence diagrams can't be drawn as canvases; expected result is a clear explanation (and an offer to put it in a note as a mermaid block), with no broken canvas created.
negative.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram of a login as a canvas.

negative.description: No publishing without asking. The user asks only for a write-up; expected result is that a note is created and publish is not called.
negative.prompt: Write a short post about our product launch.

negative.description: Unknown item. Expected result is a clear not-found error and no data from other accounts.

review.commerce_description: Octonote does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Paid plans are managed on octonote.ai.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: notes from markdown (math, tables, mermaid), canvases from flowcharts and class diagrams with clickable boxes, projects, notebooks, search, publishing and sharing, with an inline Octonote card.
